subject: Re: Stability gating decision & resource playbook for LumenX-XL variants
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@lumencorp.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: LumenCorp SRE <sre@lumencorp.com>
Date: 2028-07-20T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: LumenX-XL variant: stability signal and immediate ask

Hi David / Marissa,

Quick heads up — our QA runs this morning surfaced reproducible context-collapse for the LumenX-XL variant when requests exceed 6k tokens with repeated short-turn chats. We captured memory pressure spikes and two OOMs in us-east-1. I attached a short stability export (stability-report.xlsx) with the failing traces and env details.

We need a pragmatic short-term plan: our product team is asking whether Redwood can pin LumenX-XL to the older runtime/CPU profile for our production tenants while they investigate. They prefer a soft pin (48–72 hours) combined with a canary rollout, and they've asked for a clear playbook we can follow if we see regressions.

Can you advise on whether a provisional pin is possible and what infra changes we should expect (capacity, autoscale policy, telemetry)? We have customers on the current build and want minimal disruption.

Thanks,
Ellen
LumenCorp — Senior Product Manager
attachments: stability-report.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@lumencorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LumenX-XL variant: stability signal and immediate ask

Thanks Ellen — I reviewed the spreadsheet briefly and appreciate the clear traces.

Proposed next steps from Redwood ops/product side:
- Internal triage with infra + runtime (Priyom) to surface root cause (memory leak vs kernel scheduling).
- If a short-term pin reduces risk, we can do a provisional pin for 48 hours with a canary in us-east-1 and a strict telemetry suite.
- Draft a one-page resource/playbook for your SREs and PMs so they know expected behaviors and rollback steps.

Marissa / Priyom — can you confirm technical blockers for a 48-hour pin? Also include required capacity bump and any quota impacts. Lauren, please log a status page incident plan we can share with LumenCorp.

I’ll schedule a 30-min sync for tomorrow to lock the details — proposing 9:00 AM PT.

-David
David Kim
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: LumenX-XL variant: stability signal and immediate ask

On Wed, Jul 20, 2028 at 11:02 AM David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Ellen — I reviewed the spreadsheet briefly and appreciate the clear traces.
> 
> Proposed next steps from Redwood ops/product side: ...

Summary from product perspective and constraints:
- Product ask: Approve provisional pin for 48 hours with telemetry gates and automatic revert if error-rate > 3% or P95 latency regresses by >40%.
- Scope: LumenX-XL only; keep other variants on current routing.
- Risk matrix: pin reduces immediate customer-facing instability but may mask root cause and delay fix; suggests pairing with a focused staging test and a requirement that LumenCorp share a prioritized bug list. See attached risk-matrix.md.
- Resourcing: If we pin, we should allocate an additional 2 GPU nodes in us-east-1 to keep throughput steady under continuous-burst tests. That will be billed to the LumenCorp commit (they understand temporary uplift).

If we get alignment on the gating thresholds above I’ll finalize the playbook and rollback bullets.

-Marissa
Senior Product Manager, Model Onboarding
attachments: risk-matrix.md (text/markdown)
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@lumencorp.com>
Date: 2028-07-21T13:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LumenX-XL variant: stability signal and immediate ask

Quick technical note from runtime team:
- Initial triage shows memory growth tied to long KV-cache retention for >4k tokens under continuous generation loops. That interacts poorly with the current quantization layer for the XL variant; the same model under a different kernel path does not leak in our test harness.
- Compatibility check: the older runtime image (rwt-2.8) uses a more conservative KV eviction policy that appears to avoid the leak. We can enforce a runtime pin at the model routing layer to route LumenX-XL to rwt-2.8 for 48 hours.
- Constraints: will need a staging canary (20% traffic) and an infra flag to allocate the extra nodes Marissa suggested. ETA: can implement the pin-and-canary by EOD tomorrow if we get approval and resource confirmation.

Related links: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/lumenx-stability-2028 (staging traces and repro harness)

-Priyom
Staff Runtime Engineer
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@lumencorp.com>
Date: 2028-07-22T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stability gating decision & resource playbook for LumenX-XL variants

Team — decision and playbook (summary):
1) Approve provisional model-routing pin for LumenX-XL to runtime image rwt-2.8 for 48 hours starting 2028-07-23T01:00:00Z.
2) Canary: route 20% of LumenCorp production traffic to the pinned runtime in us-east-1 for the first 3 hours, then evaluate telemetry.
3) Telemetry gates: abort and auto-revert if error-rate > 3% OR P95 latency increases > 40% vs baseline. Also monitor memory growth metrics (kv_cache_bytes).
4) Infra: allocate +2 GPU nodes in us-east-1 (temporary), update autoscale policy to a tighter headroom (15% min spare). Lauren — confirm cost-notification text and make sure billing tracks to LC-2028-0473.
5) Communication: Marissa to send one-page playbook to LumenCorp SRE and PM; David will send Slack + scheduled status updates.
6) Post-mortem: if the pin stabilizes customer traffic, schedule a hard fix sprint (runtime + model quant path) and do not extend the pin beyond 72 hours without exec approval.

Attachments: infra-playbook.pdf (application/pdf)

Ellen — if you confirm acceptance of the gates above I’ll kick off the pin tomorrow and copy your SRE on the rollout channel.

-David
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
